title: Siege of Lens
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Lens", at revision 1370742876, opens: "The Siege of Lens was an episode of the Thirty Years' War.
It was organised in 1647 by Jean de Gassion, Marshal of France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18785783, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1647 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
